name: Undamaged Venom Sac
summary: An undamaged venom sac is a fresh spider sample sought by Apothecary Lydon in Tarren Mill. He wants its venom for experiments.

sections.title: A Fresh Sample
sections.body: Near the troll city of Shadra'Alor in the Hinterlands, spiders carry the venom sac Apothecary Lydon seeks. He needs an undamaged one, still fresh, for his experiments. Bring it to him in Tarren Mill.

faq.answer: Apothecary Lydon in Tarren Mill wants a fresh, undamaged venom sac for experiments.

faq.q: Where can I find the spiders?
faq.answer: The spiders Lydon seeks dwell in the Hinterlands, near the troll city of Shadra'Alor.

faq.q: What does Lydon want to do with it?
faq.answer: Lydon wants to study the fresh venom in experiments on small animals.

faq.q: Why must the sac be undamaged?
faq.answer: Lydon asks for an undamaged sac so its venom remains fresh for his experiments.
